metadata.method: Relative elevation to WAMIS river drainage context from Copernicus DEM grid.
limitations: Gauge water-level datum is not converted to DEM vertical datum.
Nearest-drainage elevation is estimated from coarse processed DEM grid cells.
Connectivity is approximate and not a hydraulic routing calculation.
